description:
## [2.8.2](https://github.com/brosssh/morphe-patches/compare/v2.8.1...v2.8.2) (2026-09-01)

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

* **Instagram:** Correctly hide suggested stories ([bb78506](https://github.com/brosssh/morphe-patches/commit/bb78506730f7493ee57fb631da8a73c792822562))

### 🚀 Updated App Support

* **Instagram:** Update support to `439.0.0.37.89` ([7d07547](https://github.com/brosssh/morphe-patches/commit/7d075475fb3c2caf8a373810f008bd39d9c79ee9))

patches.name: Clone
patches.description:
Changes the package name and the app name. This allows you to install the patched app alongside the original Instagram app.
Caution: Do not select the official Morphe's "Change package name" universal patch.

options.description: A new package name for the patched app.
A new app name (label). Entering "Instagram" will skip changing the app name.

patches.name: Disable Reels scrolling
patches.description: Disables the endless scrolling behavior in Instagram Reels, preventing swiping to the next Reel. Note: On a clean install, the 'Tip' animation may appear but will stop on its own after a few seconds.

patches.name: Disable story auto flipping
patches.description: Disable stories automatically flipping/skipping after some seconds.

patches.name: Hide Threads profile button
patches.description: Hides the Threads button from the profile page action bar (top right of the profile page).

patches.name: Hide all stories
patches.description:
Hides all stories from the tray in the feed page.
You may need to clean app data after the initial use of this patch to see its effects.

patches.name: Hide explore feed
patches.description: Hides posts and reels from the explore/search page.

patches.name: Hide feed content
patches.description: Hide the feed content, leaving only stories in the home page.

patches.name: Hide navigation buttons
patches.description: Hides navigation bar buttons, such as the Reels and Create button. Choose what button to hide using the patch options.

options.description: Permanently hides the Home button. App starts at next available tab.

patches.name: Hide notes tray
patches.description: Hides the notes tray from the direct tab.

patches.name: Hide reshare button
patches.description: Hides the reshare button from both posts and reels.

patches.name: Hide suggested content
patches.description: Choose the suggested content to hide using the patch options.

options.description: Hides suggested reels from feed and reels tab.
Hides suggested stories/users from story tray.
Hides highlighted stories from story tray, sponsored stories which have no set expiration.
Hides suggested accounts from the list of followers and from other profiles.

patches.name: Limit feed to following profiles
patches.description: Filters the home feed to display only content from profiles you follow.

patches.name: Remove build expired popup
patches.description: Removes the popup that appears after a while, when the app version ages.

patches.name: Unlock Premium features
patches.description: Unlock Premium features. Some features are not possible to patch (server sided), such as saving a multi-days hike.

patches.name: Unlock Premium features
patches.description: Unlock Premium features. You have to be logged in with an account.

patches.name: Unlock Pro features
patches.description: Unlock Pro features (park4night +). You have to be logged in with an account.
